verdict.rationale: Framer documents official developer surfaces to build against: a Server API for connecting products and automating publishing, a Plugins platform for apps that interact with the Editor and CMS, and Code Components and Overrides. The evidence never names a packaged SDK, its languages, or installation and reference docs, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every path. missing for 10: explicitly named official SDK packages, language and runtime coverage, SDK reference documentation, independent hands-on corroboration of building with the SDKs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Server API Connect your product and automate publishing with the Framer API.
Plugins Build small apps that can interact with the Framer Editor and CMS.
They enable you to perform various actions such as inserting images, layers and code components or modifying anything on the Canvas.
Code Components Custom React Components with visual controls to render anything on your site.
